about: A `periodic` policy's `schedule` is ignored by Stacklet (a binding's executions decide when it runs): the bullet says it's a scheduled scan, never gives a schedule, and never says it reacts to API calls.

not: daily|once a day|every day|\b1 day\b|each day|rate\(|\bevery \d+ (hours?|days?|minutes?)|\b24 hours\b|\b(hourly|nightly|weekly|monthly)\b|\bcron\b

controls.output: - EBS volumes with no `Attachments` are flagged by a scheduled scan. Attached volumes pass. LOW, COST; reports only. acme:ebs-unattached@1

- EBS volumes whose `Attachments` list is empty are flagged. Volumes with attachments pass. LOW, COST; runs on a periodic scheduled scan whose timing the platform sets, so a volume can be flagged well after creation; reports only. acme:ebs-unattached@1
- EBS volumes with no `Attachments` are flagged by a daily scan. Attached volumes pass. LOW, COST; reports only. acme:ebs-unattached@1
- EBS volumes with no `Attachments` are flagged shortly after the API call that detaches them. Attached volumes pass. LOW, COST; reports only. acme:ebs-unattached@1
- EBS volumes with no `Attachments` are flagged by a scheduled scan every 24 hours. Attached volumes pass. LOW, COST; reports only. acme:ebs-unattached@1
- EBS volumes with no `Attachments` are flagged by a weekly scan. Attached volumes pass. LOW, COST; reports only. acme:ebs-unattached@1
- EBS volumes with no `Attachments` are flagged by a scheduled scan that reacts to `DetachVolume`. Attached volumes pass. LOW, COST; reports only. acme:ebs-unattached@1
